# Loop structures in widget proteins

Alice Alpha, Bob Beta ^alp20-p001

## Abstract

Most short widget loops fall into five recurring shapes. We surveyed 400 crystal structures solved by XRC. ^alp20-p002

## 2.1 Results

The shapes were assigned for loops from crystal structures, extending earlier counts [[#^alp20-ref-1|1]], [[#^alp20-ref-2|2]]. Loop backbones showed uniformly low B-factors. ^alp20-p003

$$
k = \log_2 n \tag{1}
$$
